topic: Opt-out MAC endpoint and website updates
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on the technical implementation for handling opt-out MAC addresses. [p1] inquired about an existing endpoint to post MAC data. Someone confirmed that while a mechanism exists (referencing AU-46), its impact is uncertain and requires code review. The conversation noted that the old website handles this MAC input, but [p1] plans to implement a more robust solution on the new site, despite the current technical difficulties with WordPress.
decisions: The existing endpoint for opt-out MAC data needs code inspection to confirm its functionality.
action_items: Someone needs to review the code of the old website to understand how MAC addresses are currently processed and determine feasibility for implementation on the new site.
